follows: Route 46 (the diagonal pentagon closes raw on the y-orbit)

gates.claim: THE FORM. The Rogers-L Galois sum over the 5_2 saddle roots is pi^2/2 - (2pi/3)*arg(y_1) -- only pi^2 and pi times an ANGLE, with NO log-squared term, unlike every previous form of the sum rule. Equivalently 11pi^2/6 - 2 pi Theta via 3*Theta = 2pi + arg(y_1), also gated

it is EQUIVALENT to the sum rule, not a weakening: L = Li2 + log*log/2, so P = A + (1/2)*sum log y log(1-y) with the log-product Galois sum elementary. A is checked against the value the sum rule forces, so the chain from this form back to the original statement is closed

the diagonal pentagon 2P + 2Q + R = 3pi^2/2 holds exactly, but does NOT decompose: P is elementary with small coefficients while PSLQ finds nothing for Q or for R at maxcoeff 1e7. So the relation says only that 2Q + R is elementary -- one equation in two unknowns, closing nothing. (Absence of a PSLQ hit is evidence, not proof, and is reported as such)

the diagonal pentagon LEAVES the unit tower of Routes 40-41: N(1+y) = 7, so 1/(1+y) is not an algebraic integer and its minimal polynomial 7x^3-10x^2+5x-1 is not monic. The prime 7 enters here -- worth flagging in a lane named for a level-7 ladder, though no connection to that ladder is measured

the five-to-three collapse is a Z/2, NOT an S3: the x<->y swap induces (0 1)(2 4)(3) on the five arguments -- cycle type [1,2,2], a reflection -- and on the diagonal its orbits become multiplicities [2,2,1]. The S3 in this subject is the anharmonic group <z->1-z, z->1/z> acting on a SINGLE argument, which is a different action entirely

verdict.form: sum_sigma L(y_sigma) = pi^2/2 - (2pi/3)*arg(y_1), residual 9e-61 -- the cleanest statement of the sum rule so far, with no log-squared term, only pi^2 and pi times an angle.
verdict.why_it_matters: that is the shape a Chern-Simons / flattening statement takes, which is formal support for the extended-Bloch framing of Routes 42-46 rather than another reformulation for its own sake.
verdict.what_it_does_not_give: the pentagon it came from does not decompose -- Q and R are individually non-elementary, so 2Q + R = elementary is one equation in two unknowns. And the diagonal leaves the unit tower: N(1+y) = 7.
